name: Lanamon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits among them to the hand or place 1 such card as any of your blue Digimon's bottom digivolution card. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may return 1 level 3 Digimon to the hand.
